channel.title: News AI Engine
channel.description: Practical guides, tutorials and case studies on AI-powered news automation, automated YouTube and TikTok production, FFmpeg, Python video processing and motion graphics - written from building and running a real AI video engine.

item.title: Inside an AI News Video Pipeline: From Headline to Finished Video
item.description: How our News AI Engine turns one headline into a narrated, edited, quality-checked video - every stage explained, with the trade-offs.

item.title: AI Script Generation for News Videos: Structure, Length and Factual Guard-rails
item.description: How we prompt and validate AI models to write gripping 60-second news scripts that stay factual: structured output, timed length and claim checks.

item.title: Why Our AI Scripts Kept Failing: A 504 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED Case Study
item.description: Our AI script stage failed more than it succeeded. The cause was timeouts, retries and fallback wiring - not the prompt. Diagnosis and fix.

item.title: Building a Multi-Provider AI Router With Fallbacks, Circuit Breakers and Validation
item.description: A practical Python design for calling several AI providers reliably: model chains, error classes, repair retries, health and cost logs.

item.title: Stop AI Preambles From Reaching Your Text-to-Speech
item.description: Headings, stage directions and 'Here is your script' notes were read aloud by our narrator. The cleaner that keeps only speakable text.

item.title: Forced Alignment With whisper.cpp: Word-Accurate Captions on a Phone
item.description: Time every spoken word for captions and graphics by aligning whisper.cpp word timestamps to your known script - running on a phone.

item.title: Building a 3-Second Montage With FFmpeg xfade (and the Transition That Crashed)
item.description: Build a 3-second news montage with FFmpeg xfade from Python: segment maths, crossfade chains, low-memory grouping and a crashing transition.

item.title: Remotion vs libass: Choosing a Motion Graphics Renderer for Automated Video
item.description: Remotion rendered at 11 seconds per second of video on our hardware, so automated news graphics moved to libass. A measured comparison.

item.title: Animating News Graphics With ASS Subtitles: Typing, Kinetic Text and Wipes
item.description: Generate broadcast-style motion graphics as ASS subtitle files in Python and burn them into video with FFmpeg - lower thirds, typing and kinetic text.

item.title: Designing an AI Visual Director That Doesn't Overdo It
item.description: Letting AI choose video graphics is easy; stopping it from overdoing them is hard. The rules our Visual Director enforces in code.

item.title: AI Visual Scanning of a Footage Library With Vision Models
item.description: Using vision-language models to describe a footage library once, cache it, and match shots to narration - with batching that cut calls by six.

item.title: TikTok Content Posting API Explained: Direct Post, Inbox Uploads and the Audit
item.description: Publishing through TikTok's official Content Posting API: OAuth with PKCE, creator info, chunked uploads, status checks and the audit.

item.title: Scheduling Social Video Uploads Safely: Idempotency, Missed Slots and Restarts
item.description: Build a publishing scheduler that never double-posts, never dumps overdue videos at once and survives restarts - fixed slots and SQLite.

item.title: Automated Quality Control for Generated Videos With ffprobe and FFmpeg
item.description: The 30 automated checks we run on generated videos before publishing: format, silence, black frames, captions, sync and leaked AI text.

item.title: Rendering Long YouTube Videos on an Android Phone: Chunked Montages and Real Costs
item.description: How we render multi-minute 16:9 YouTube videos with synced graphics on a phone: chunked montages, bounded memory, resumable stages, real timings.

item.title: Running a Python Video Pipeline in Termux: Setup, Limits and Lessons
item.description: Run Python, FFmpeg and whisper.cpp on an Android phone with Termux: setup, real limits, and habits that keep a phone-based pipeline stable.
